segments.text: Burnout never announces itself. Late nights, weekend sprints, and rising workloads hide in everyday data until your best people quit.
Meet Employetics — the AI workforce platform that reads daily hours, tasks, and feedback to predict who is heading for burnout.
It shows managers the real drivers, while giving employees private one-minute check-ins that are never shared with HR.
Rebalance workloads in a single click, or ask the AI HR Copilot anything directly from your live team data.
Act weeks before the resignation letter — and keep your highest performers healthy and thriving.
Employetics. Predict burnout. Keep your people.
